offering_description.value: Designs and supplies prescription devices for patients who manage lymphedema, chronic swelling or impaired airway clearance at home. It supplies compression systems directly to patients and sells airway clearance vests through home medical equipment suppliers.

primary_products.value: Pneumatic compression systems and garments; oscillating airway clearance vests

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients prescribed home compression therapy; B2B: Home medical equipment suppliers serving patients with chronic respiratory conditions; B2G: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs healthcare facilities

end_markets.value: Home healthcare; lymphedema and chronic edema care; respiratory care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Insurer and Medicare payments for covered home compression devices; product sales: Airway clearance vests sold to home medical equipment suppliers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops devices using sourced components and manufacturing partners for patients and home medical equipment suppliers

geography_served.value: US national: Patients and home medical equipment suppliers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Home pneumatic compression systems and wearable airway clearance devices

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Clinical sales team works with prescribers and supplies compression devices directly to patients; distributors / dealers: Home medical equipment suppliers provide airway clearance vests to patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription devices subject to FDA clearance and quality requirements, with Medicare coverage and billing rules
